title: Unable to change DynamicISF Adjustment Factor % Value
body:
Build: 3.3.1.0

I appear unable to adjust the `DynamicISF Adjustment Factor % Value` value found in `OpenAPS SMB` preferences. After I input a new value and click "OK", it continues to show the old value. Please see video for a clear understanding of this issue.

I believe this issue is new after I upgraded from 3.2.0.4 to 3.3.1.0

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/fe671f75-7fad-405d-b151-fd1f15b17180

comments.body:
I'll share a workaround i know have worked for others having this issue until other solutions are found. I can't guarantee that it will work so do it only if you feel it's worth the risk. 

1. You need to have backup of data at Nightscout and can use NSClientv3 to restore data with full sync after. 
2. **!! Backup settings in Maintenance > export settings !!**
3. Uninstall AAPS
4. Install AAPS
5. Import settings
6. Do a full sync with NSClientv3

I reproduced it on my test rig.
Steps: 
1. Downgrade to 3.2 from 3.3
2. Activate dynisf plugin and adjust the DynISF adjustment factor to something else.
3. Upgrade to 3.3
